inputClasses: acceptance form {pack, candidateBuild} in an isolated evaluator session

parameterRanges.out: findings directory that does not exist

invariants: a conforming export passes; a nonconforming style verdict is gateFailed with verdict fail and fail dominates incomplete
a missing capability (no style-lint handler, no renderer, no consumer) reports incomplete, never pass and never fail; required artifacts carry null hashes

each declared mutant class produces verdict fail and exit 1: identity transform (spec.identityEdit), wrong units (spec.scale), discarded morphs (spec.expressions.binds + expression.blinkInert), broken eyelids (expression.blinkInert), fabricated report (reportBindingMismatch)
report hashes bind the exact input bytes: a rebuilt file against an old plan is reportBindingMismatch
the acceptance form requires VRM_AUTHOR_SESSION=harness and creates no output otherwise; handlers never write evidence.json
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: metres (scale check), normalized morph weights, sha256 hashes
excluded: Metal rendering (renderer absent in the suite; render scenarios report incomplete)
python style lint (a stub handler supplies the verdict)

mutants.description: QAMutantInjectionTests.testIdentityTransformMutantIsFlaggedNoOpEdit: a pack that ignores body.heightM must fail spec.identityEdit (noOpEdit) while the honest pack passes.
QAMutantInjectionTests.testWrongUnitsMutantFailsScale: a 160 m (centimetre) avatar and a 0.2 m avatar must fail spec.scale.
QAMutantInjectionTests.testDiscardedMorphsMutantFailsExpressionBinds: stripping primitive targets and targetNames must fail spec.expressions.binds and expression.blinkInert.
QAMutantInjectionTests.testBrokenEyelidsMutantFailsBlinkInert: a blink morph that moves nothing must fail expression.blinkInert (EXPRESSION_INERT).

QAMutantInjectionTests.testFabricatedReportFailsInspectionVerify: an honest incomplete report rewritten to pass with fff... hashes, and a verdict-only forgery, must both be gateFailed/reportBindingMismatch.
testQARunPlanFormVerifiesPlanAndFileBinding: wrong sha, tampered scenario list and a rebuilt file must each be rejected.
testAcceptanceFormRequiresIsolatedEvaluatorSession: the acceptance form must be missingCapability outside VRM_AUTHOR_SESSION=harness and create no output; an unknown candidate build is missingInput.
testHandlersNeverWriteTheEvidenceRegistry: no Export/QA handler source may reference evidence.json or the acceptance packs directory for writing.

A report envelope claiming every QAPackTests test passed (executed 11, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/QA/QAPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: qa run is numeric and structural checking whose visual scenarios are owned by the visual packs (control set, build, export vrm) and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
